elaine: quick favor — I'm chasing a small-batch throughput regression on ded-gpu. Can someone on the rtx pool run a short nsys + torch.profiler capture and share the scrubbed trace? commit: d4e1f2c
max: I can run a mini-capture this afternoon. do you want full nsys (`--capture-range=...`) or a sampled run?
tj: sampled please — keep it <= 30s so CI artifacts don't explode. also we need torch profiler timeline for op-level hotspots.
elaine: perfect. here's the 'mini-trace' recipe we use for quick triage (no user data). run on a single replica with model pinned; 30s max.

```bash
# nsys sampled capture (recommended for quick checks)
nsys profile \
  --output mini_trace_ns \
  --sample=cpu \
  --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi:start,cudaProfilerApi:stop \
  --force \
  --stats=true \
  --timeout=35s \
  -- python -u serve_local.py --model ./weights --batch-size 1 --max-steps 50
```

```py
# torch.profiler snippet (inside a short driver) — dump chrome trace
with torch.profiler.profile(
    activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    record_shapes=True,
    with_stack=False,
    profile_memory=True,
    on_trace_ready=torch.profiler.tensorboard_trace_handler('./tb_dir')
):
    run_inference_loop(steps=50)
```

elaine: after capture, please run `tools/scrub_trace.py mini_trace_ns.nsys --remove-rows kv_cache --anonymize` before uploading. scrub script strips prompt/user tokens and any large KV dumps.
max: got it. where to upload? GCS or the internal trace bucket?
elaine: internal trace bucket is fine: gs://redwood-traces/triage/<thread_ts>/ (use thread id 1998765432). If upload hits size limit, convert to flamegraph svg: `nsys profile --report=flamegraph` or `nsys-ui` export.
runtime-ci-bot: note: max single artifact size is 200MB. If your .nsys file >200MB, run `nsys profile --sample=cpu --timeout=20s` or gzip and attach to the infra ticket.
infra: also add the reproducer command + env: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, driver version, container image tag. that saves everyone time.
tj: pinging @max — once uploaded, drop a link here and tag me. I'll run a quick diff against the golden flamegraph we have for commit c1b2a3.
max: starting capture now, will scrub and upload in ~25m :thumbsup:
elaine: thank you! if you hit nvtx-less traces, include the small python driver I shared in #eng-runtime earlier. and please include the raw torchprof tb_dir too (we can parse it).
